People need to understand that the infinitive HAS to be presented with the particle "to" in order to be considered verbs to be listed and studied, or else, if presented just as is, the interpretation is that of the imperative. So, a verb presented as "play" should NOT be "autotranslated" as "jugar" because "jugar" is infinitive and should be presented as "TO PLAY", not just "play". Thank you. Still, great interface and images. Keep the good work.
